map.关于「新生儿胆红素单位换算」: About the Newborn Jaundice (Hour-Specific Bilirubin) Curve Tool
map.AAP 2022（Kemper et al., Pediatrics 2022;: AAP 2022 (Kemper et al., Pediatrics 2022;150(3):e2022060643) has superseded AAP 2004
map.通用换算系数（胆红素分子量 584.7 g/mol：1 mg/dL ≈ 17.1: General conversion factor (bilirubin molecular weight 584.7 g/mol: 1 mg/dL ≈ 17.1 μmol/L)
map.换算血清总胆红素单位并记录出生小时和胎龄，不提供治疗阈值或风险判定: Convert total serum bilirubin units and record age and gestation. No treatment threshold or risk assessment is provided.
map.本页换算血清总胆红素单位，不作疾病诊断或治疗决定。: This page converts total serum bilirubin units and does not diagnose or make treatment decisions.
map.AAP 2022 黄疸指南适用于胎龄 ≥35 周的新生儿；胎龄 <35 周须单独: The 2022 AAP jaundice guideline applies to infants born at 35 weeks or later; earlier gestations require separate assessment. This tool provides no treatment thresholds.
map.血清总胆红素 μmol/L = mg/dL × 17.1。换算结果不能判断是否需: Total serum bilirubin in μmol/L = mg/dL × 17.1. Conversion cannot determine the need for phototherapy or exchange transfusion.
map.出生体重低于 2500 g 为低出生体重；SGA 需按胎龄及性别对应出生体重百分: Birth weight below 2500 g is low birth weight; SGA requires assessment against birth-weight percentiles for gestational age and sex, not weight alone.
map.出现喂养困难、难以唤醒、肌张力异常或其他令人担忧的症状，应立即就医。治疗决策由医: Seek immediate medical care for feeding difficulties, difficulty waking, abnormal muscle tone or other concerning symptoms. Clinicians assess treatment using gestational age, postnatal age, bilirubin and risk factors.
map.📚 深度解析：新生儿胆红素单位换算: 📚 In depth: Newborn bilirubin unit conversion
map.记录出生后小时数及胆红素测量值。: Record postnatal age in hours and bilirubin measurement.
map.治疗决策须由临床人员结合胎龄、小时龄与风险因素评估。: Clinicians must assess treatment using gestational age, postnatal age and risk factors.
map.总胆红素 10 mg/dL × 17.1 = 171 μmol/L；换算本身不表: Total bilirubin 10 mg/dL × 17.1 = 171 μmol/L; conversion alone does not indicate risk or a treatment threshold.
map.低体重是否等于 SGA？: Is low birth weight the same as SGA?
map.不是。SGA 需要按胎龄与性别的出生体重百分位评估。: No. SGA requires assessment of birth weight percentiles by gestational age and sex.
map.AAP 2022 指南适用于哪些胎龄？: Which gestational ages does the 2022 AAP guideline cover?
map.该指南适用于胎龄至少 35 周的新生儿；低于 35 周需单独专业评估。: The guideline applies to infants born at 35 weeks or later; earlier gestations require separate clinical assessment.
